title: Roots-of-unity computation on the two lines
statement: Let k be an algebraically closed field, m>=1 invertible in k, and zeta a primitive mth root in k. Let C_false=Spec k[t] and C_true=Spec k[t,t^-1], with the standard inclusion and actual Kummer boundary and root restriction [def-pur-kummer-line-geometry]. Each H^0(C_b,mu_m) has a linear isomorphism from ULift(ZMod m) taking 1 to the constant root section z_b defined by zeta, and restriction carries z_false to z_true. H^q(C_b,mu_m) vanishes for q>(if b then 1 else 0). For any proof hm that m is invertible in the global functions of C_true, there is a linear isomorphism ULift(ZMod m) to H^1(C_true,mu_m) taking 1 to the actual Kummer boundary of t.

proof.text: Both schemes are connected, as spectra of domains. The primitive-root trivialization identifies the roots sheaf with the constant Z/m sheaf. Constant sections on a connected scheme are exactly the constants. Evaluate the sheafification unit and the trivialization at the identity terminal object: 1 maps to the displayed scalar root zeta. These additive equivalences are linear for the lifted residue ring.

source.place: Proof, Coefficients, Clause (c), and Degrees 0 and 1; Stacks etale-cohomology.tex, section-kummer (03PK), lemma-kummer-sequence (03PL), theorem-vanishing-affine-curves (03SC)(2)

proof.text: The root restriction commutes with inclusion in the unit sheaf. The degree-zero cohomology map on units is pullback of actual units. Pulling the scalar root along the open inclusion gives the same scalar on the punctured line because inclusion followed by the affine-line structure map is the punctured-line structure map. Injectivity of the root inclusion therefore gives restriction(z_false)=z_true.

source.place: Proof, Coefficients, Clause (c), and Degrees 0 and 1; Stacks etale-cohomology.tex, section-kummer (03PK), lemma-kummer-sequence (03PL), theorem-vanishing-affine-curves (03SC)(2)

proof.text: The affine line has dimension at most one by the polynomial Krull-dimension formula. The punctured line is its principal open t not equal to zero, hence has dimension at most one. Both structure morphisms are separated, quasi-compact and locally of finite type. Multiplication by m annihilates the roots sheaf by the kernel condition, so it is torsion. The affine cohomological-dimension theorem gives vanishing for all q>1 on both curves.

source.place: Proof, Coefficients, Clause (c), and Degrees 0 and 1; Stacks etale-cohomology.tex, section-kummer (03PK), lemma-kummer-sequence (03PL), theorem-vanishing-affine-curves (03SC)(2)

proof.text: The Kummer exact sequence says that the kernel of its degree-zero boundary is the subgroup of mth powers and its cokernel maps into H^1(Gm). Both Picard groups vanish, and Pic is canonically H^1(Gm), so the boundary is surjective. On the affine line its unit group is k-units; algebraic closure makes all these units mth powers, so H^1 is zero.

source.place: Proof, Coefficients, Clause (c), and Degrees 0 and 1; Stacks etale-cohomology.tex, section-kummer (03PK), lemma-kummer-sequence (03PL), theorem-vanishing-affine-curves (03SC)(2)

proof.text: On the punctured line the first isomorphism theorem identifies H^1(mu_m) with the quotient of the unit group by mth powers. The explicit unit-quotient isomorphism gives (k-units modulo mth powers) times Multiplicative(ZMod m). The first factor is trivial by algebraic closure. Invert the resulting isomorphism to obtain the additive equivalence ZMod m to H^1. The explicit quotient formula for t fixes its value at 1 as the actual boundary of t. Lift the source ring and use automatic residue-ring linearity.

lean.statement:
theorem kummer_root_line_computation (k : Type u) [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k]
    (m : ℕ) (hmpos : 1 ≤ m) (hmk : IsUnit (m : k))
    (ζ : kˣ) (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ m)
    (hm : IsUnit (m : Γ(curve k true, ⊤))) :
    ∃ z : (b : Bool) → Sheaf.H ((curve k b).rootsOfUnitySheaf m) 0,
      (∀ b : Bool,
        (kernel.ι (m • 𝟙 (curve k b).gmSheaf)).hom.app
            (op (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 (curve k b))))
            (Sheaf.H.equiv₀ ((curve k b).rootsOfUnitySheaf m)
              (MorphismProperty.Over.mkIdTerminal @Etale (curve k b)) (z b)) =
          ULift.up (Additive.ofMul (Units.map (scalar k b).toMonoidHom ζ))) ∧
      rootRestriction k m 0 (z false) = z true ∧
      (∀ b : Bool, ∃ e : ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod m) ≃ₗ[ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod m)]
          Sheaf.H ((curve k b).rootsOfUnitySheaf m) 0, e 1 = z b) ∧
      (∀ (b : Bool) (q : ℕ), (if b then 1 else 0) < q →
        Subsingleton (Sheaf.H ((curve k b).rootsOfUnitySheaf m) q)) ∧
      (∃ e : ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod m) ≃ₗ[ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod m)]
          Sheaf.H ((curve k true).rootsOfUnitySheaf m) 1,
        e 1 = generator k m hm)
